name: qwen-coder
description: Lightweight agentic coding assistant powered by your local Qwen3-Coder via llama.cpp. Like Claude Code / Copilot, but 100% local.

commands.title: Qwen Coder: Switch Model (local / Copilot / Claude)
Qwen Coder: Set Claude API Key

qwenCoder.endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL of your llama.cpp server (run with --jinja). Machine-scoped so a workspace cannot override it.

qwenCoder.model.description: Model name sent in the request (llama.cpp ignores it, but some servers require it).

qwenCoder.temperature.description: Lower = more decisive (good for agent/coding). 0.2 recommended.

qwenCoder.maxIterations.description: Max tool-call iterations per request before the agent stops.

qwenCoder.autoApproveCommands.description: Run shell commands WITHOUT asking. Leave OFF for safety (assisted mode).

qwenCoder.apiKey.description: Optional bearer token if your local endpoint requires auth. Machine-scoped.

qwenCoder.provider.description: Model backend: 'local' = your llama.cpp/Ollama endpoint; 'copilot' = GitHub Copilot models (includes Claude); 'anthropic' = Claude via API key. Use the 'Switch Model' command to pick interactively.

qwenCoder.anthropicApiKey.description: Optional Claude API key. Resolution order: keychain ('Set Claude API Key' command) → this setting → ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var (same one Claude Code uses; requires launching VS Code from a terminal via `code .`). Tip: Claude is also free via the 'copilot' provider if your plan includes it.
